data.one_liner: Token refresh library exposing core components for custom OAuth2 and auth refresh implementations.
data.what_it_does: Provides core components like FreshMixin and TokenStorage to handle token lifecycle management, token refresh deduplication, and stream-based authentication status. It is designed to be used when building custom token refresh integrations for HTTP clients like package:http.
use_when: You are building a custom auth refresh integration for package:http or another non-Dio client.
You need centralized single-flight token refresh coordination to prevent concurrent refresh calls.
You want stream-based tracking of authentication status (initial, authenticated, unauthenticated).
avoid_when: You are using the dio HTTP client (use fresh_dio instead).
You are using GraphQL with gql_link (use fresh_graphql instead).
strengths: Handles single-flight refresh coordination automatically so concurrent refresh attempts share one in-flight operation.
Provides token storage abstractions and standard OAuth2 token classes.
weaknesses: Requires manual implementation for custom HTTP clients compared to ready-made integration packages.
Most users must use separate integration packages (fresh_dio or fresh_graphql) rather than package:fresh directly.
